question: Who among the following created history by scoring 9000 runs in T20 in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Virat Kohli**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Virat Kohli** created history by becoming the first cricketer to score **9000 runs in T20 cricket** in May **2025**, setting a new benchmark for excellence in the shortest format of the game.
 
• Kohli's achievement is a testament to his consistency, adaptability, and proficiency across various formats of cricket, and his ability to excel under pressure in diverse conditions.
 
• The milestone was achieved during a **domestic T20 league** match, where Kohli showcased his trademark batting prowess and resilience.
 
• **Virat Kohli** is widely regarded as one of the greatest batsmen in cricket history, with numerous records in all formats, including his ability to chase targets successfully in limited-overs cricket.
 
• Kohli's achievement further solidifies his position as a modern-day cricket legend and serves as an inspiration for aspiring cricketers worldwide.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Virat Kohli:**

 
 
• Born on **5th November 1988** in **Delhi, India**, Kohli is known for his aggressive batting style and leadership qualities.
 
• He has been a pivotal player for the Indian cricket team across all formats and captained the team in **Test**, **ODI**, and **T20** cricket.
 
• Kohli is the fastest player to reach milestones such as **8000**, **9000**, and **10,000 runs** in ODIs, showcasing his dominance in international cricket.
 
 
 
• **T20 Cricket:**
 
 
• T20 cricket is a format where each team bats for a maximum of **20 overs**, emphasizing quick runs and dynamic gameplay.
 
• The format was introduced in **2003** and has gained massive popularity worldwide due to its fast-paced nature and entertainment value.
 
• Major T20 leagues like the **Indian Premier League (IPL)**, **Big Bash League**, and **CPL** have played a significant role in the development of the format.
 
 
 
• **KL Rahul:**
 
 
• Another prominent Indian cricketer, KL Rahul, is known for his versatility and has been a key player in T20 leagues and international matches.
 
• Rahul has made significant contributions to Indian cricket, but he is yet to reach the milestone of **9000 runs in T20 cricket**.
 
 
 
• **Rohit Sharma:**
 
 
• Rohit Sharma, the Indian cricket team's former captain in limited-overs formats, is famous for his ability to score big hundreds in ODIs and T20s.
 
• While Rohit is among the leading run-scorers in T20 cricket, he has not achieved the **9000-run mark** yet.
 
 
 
• **Tilak Verma:**
 
 
• Tilak Verma is a young and promising cricketer who has shown great potential in domestic cricket and IPL.
 
• Despite his talent, Verma is at the beginning of his career and far from reaching the milestone of **9000 runs in T20 cricket**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Virat Kohli’s Records:**

 
 
• Kohli holds the record for the **most centuries in chasing in ODIs**, making him one of the best finishers in the game.
 
• He is the fastest player to reach **23,000 runs** in international cricket across all formats.
 
• Kohli has won multiple **ICC awards**, including the **ICC Cricketer of the Year** and **ICC ODI Player of the Year**.
 
 
 
• **Impact of T20 Cricket:**
 
 
• T20 cricket has revolutionized the game, introducing new strategies, aggressive batting, and innovative bowling techniques.
 
• Players like Kohli, Chris Gayle, and AB de Villiers have set benchmarks in the format, inspiring future generations.
